manifest.provider: FieldMaps, U.S. Department of State, U.S. Geological Survey
manifest.allowed_use: Redistributable cartographic hints, including commercial use.
manifest.transformed_fields: ADM0 land geometries and ocean polygons clipped to buffered windows in WGS84; longitude/latitude ring deltas at 1e-7 degrees.
manifest.freshness: Both source inputs are checksum-pinned. Review reclamation and land-border fixtures before updating.
manifest.confidence_notes: Coastal land representation can include inland rivers and reservoirs. Positive ocean overlap required to classify a land miss as water. Remaining gaps are unknown. Shorelines and reclaimed land depend on the survey vintage. No water jurisdiction asserted.
